regime_context: The detector shows a narrow, two-theme leadership structure in China A-shares: Banks rank 1 and Innovative Pharma & CXO rank 2, both crowded and eligible, while everything else sits below the eligibility trend-gate. Rotation breadth is narrow (4 of 22 eligible), and the backtest verdict is explicit that the absolute-trend gate did NOT hold on this market's history and momentum rank is an attention lens, not alpha. Track record (n=77, dir accuracy 0.377) warrants low conviction.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Innovative Pharma & CXO (159992.SZ) closes the rotation margin versus Banks (512800.SS) and takes the rank-1 leadership for two consecutive scoring days — a confirmed handoff, not a prediction. Retire the watch if Banks re-widens the margin to 0.03+ for three straight days.

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the confirmed leader by rank, durability-bar (0.73, highest in the tape), and breadth (0.889 — the only theme with broad participation), and it is eligible under the trend gate. This is a continuation lean on existing leadership, sized only as a stalwart, because durability and breadth are the strongest coincident read available and crowding (z=1.78, crowded=true) is a cap-and-size-down caution, never a fade.
theses.dissent: Backtest verdict says the trend gate did not hold here and this is a mean-reverting tape — a crowded, top-ranked theme in such a regime historically whipsaws, and this market's own history says the gate does not cut drawdown.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS trails CSI 300 by more than 3% before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Innovative Pharma & CXO
theses.thesis: Pharma & CXO is the confirmed challenger, ranked 2 with score 0.988 and eligible, with a durability-bar of 0.60 that is second-best and breadth of 0.643. The rotation radar names it as the challenger with a thin margin (0.01) versus Banks, so it is a legitimate co-leader in a narrow, two-theme structure rather than a fading rank.
theses.dissent: Crowding is high (z=1.59, crowded=true) and breadth is only moderate (0.643) versus Banks' 0.889; in a mean-reverting tape with no validated trend edge, the challenger can hand leadership back to Banks or both can fade together.

falsifier.text: 159992.SZ lags CSI 300 by 4% while 512800.SS stays positive before the 20-day check-by date

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is one of only four eligible themes, but its durability-bar (0.46) and breadth (0.30) are weak and its hurst_tag is 'mean-revert' — the one trend health flag in the eligible set that explicitly signals a choppy, mean-reverting profile in a market where the backtest already says the trend gate did not hold. This is a stay-away lean on rotation into weak eligibility.
theses.dissent: Coal is eligible and not crowded; in a value/cyclical tape it is a possible laggard catch-up if resources rotate, and the mean-revert tag may simply describe a range that still grinds higher.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS outperforms CSI 300 by more than 3% before the 20-day check-by date
